members.working:
Given: ΔS°_rxn(298 K) = -192 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. ΔCp = -86.0 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ (constant). At 800 K, S°(SO₂) = 301 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, S°(O₂) = 235 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. Need S°(SO₃) at 800 K.

ΔS°_rxn(T) = ΔS°_rxn(298) + ΔCp ln(T/298). So at 800 K:
ΔS°_rxn(800) = -192 + (-86.0) * ln(800/298).
Compute ln(800/298) = ln(2.6859) ≈ 0.9870.
Thus ΔS°_rxn(800) ≈ -192 - 86.0 * 0.9870 ≈ -192 - 84.8 = -276.8 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.

Standard reaction entropy relation: ΔS°_rxn = S°(SO₃) - [S°(SO₂) + S°(O₂)].
Thus S°(SO₃) = S°(SO₂) + S°(O₂) - ΔS°_rxn(800).
Plug numbers: S°(SO₃) = 301 + 235 - (-276.8) = 536 + 276.8 ≈ 812.8 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.

Using exact calculation: ΔS°_rxn(800) = -192 + (-86) * ln(800/298). Compute with tool: -192 + (-86)*ln(800/298) = -276.9266 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.
Then S°(SO₃) = 301 + 235 - (-276.9266) = 812.9266 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.
Round to three significant figures: 813 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.
